entries.en: There's an old poster written[n]in rounded letters that says,[n]"Be sure to wash your hands!"
I wonder if Sojiro wrote this...
I have gray hair...![n]My Charm is [clr 1]So-so[clr 27].
A smile came to my face when I[n]saw myself. My Charm is [clr 1]Sensible[clr 27].
I appreciated my own looks.[n]I guess it's because my[n]Charm is [clr 1]Eye-piercing[clr 27]...
There is an unmistakable charm in[n]my eyes. I could probably [clr 1]Floating[n]Pheromones[clr 27] anyone I'm talking to.
It's perfect. I will soon be known[n]as a [clr 1]Man of Devilish Charm[clr 27].
